'''Brandon Allen Hunt Down Battle and no Dueling''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Brandon Allen]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-7475">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/7475 Hunt Down Battle and no Dueling], DeckTech (Brandon "Sundevil" Allen, 11 June 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/7475/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/7475/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018163318/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/7475/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''Hunt Down Battle and no Dueling'''
* '''Author:''' Brandon "Sundevil" Allen
* '''Published:''' June 11, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' Just a battle deck.

=== Strategy ===

You all know what the strategy is. And Cloud City sites because I'm sick of having my characters become missing from Lost in the Wilderness.

Peace Out
